test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 10 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Which of the following government schemes provides subsidised food grains to poor households in India?

options.text: Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana

solution:
The correct answer is __**Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__ Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana is a government scheme launched in 2020.**
 
• Its aim was to provide subsidized food grains to poor households in India.
 
• The scheme aims to provide food security to the poor during the COVID-19 pandemic by providing 5 kg of wheat or rice and 1 kg of pulses per month for free for three months.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
• **Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana is a government scheme launched in 2015.**

 
 
• It aimed to provide skill training to youth for employability.
 
 
 
• **Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana is a government scheme launched in 2018.**
 
 
• Its aim was to provide health insurance coverage to poor households in India.
 
 
 
• **Atal Pension Yojana is a government scheme launched in 2015.**
 
 
• Its aim was to provide a defined pension to workers in the unorganised sector.
